title: Clone production instances through the SDK and CLI
description:
An agent prepares production from a candidate with one typed Orbit command and receives the target’s preview hostname and deployment state.

## Scope

* In: typed clone request and response transport, CLI candidate and Node selection, help, and supported Node-TLD guidance.
* Out: direct remote execution, automatic deployment, application readiness, source queue operations, and retirement of the older creation route.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The SDK sends the exact clone API payload, including omitted optional branch and SQLite path values, and validates the returned AppInstance and sole preview Route without applying placement policy. Proof: `packages/php-sdk/tests/Unit/Requests/AppInstances/CloneAppInstanceRequestTest.php`.
- [ ] `orbit instance:clone CANDIDATE NODE NAME --preview-name=shop.com [--branch=BRANCH] [--sqlite-source-path=PATH]` uses the SDK, with unambiguous identifiers in noninteractive or JSON mode and no local shell execution. Proof: `apps/cli/tests/Feature/Instances/CloneInstanceCommandTest.php`.
- [ ] Output identifies the target ID, configured branch, actual preview hostname, and absence of a first release; help describes source-versus-App definition selection, target-only cleanup, `node:provision --tld` for production preview setup, env updates, and separate deployment. Proof: `apps/cli/tests/Feature/Instances/CloneInstanceCommandTest.php`.
- [ ] A real operator-side clone with and without a SQLite seed returns the same target on repeat and can then be configured and explicitly deployed using the separate deployment commands; source runtime state remains unchanged. Proof: Incus action `candidate-clone-cli`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation describes candidate clone commands and production Node-TLD setup, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Changed project checks and repository suites pass. Proof: `cd packages/php-sdk && composer check`, `cd apps/cli && composer check`, and all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
